subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should OpenClaw add a targeted `/models test-fallback` command, fold the behavior into `openclaw models status --probe --all`, or defer it into staged model-migration UX?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent user-facing command contract overlaps existing auth probes plus two open model diagnostics or migration feature requests, so automation should not choose the product surface alone.

options.title: Add Targeted Fallback Probe
options.body: Add a focused slash/CLI fallback probe that starts at configured fallback candidates and supports first-fallback plus all-fallback modes.

options.title: Fold Into Status Probe
options.body: Let the broader configured-model health-check work own this behavior and make `/models` only a wrapper or discovery path.

options.title: Defer To Migration UX
options.body: Treat fallback testing as one step of staged model migration and avoid a standalone command until that flow is scoped.

recommendation.title: Add Targeted Fallback Probe
recommendation.body: Add a focused slash/CLI fallback probe that starts at configured fallback candidates and supports first-fallback plus all-fallback modes.

likelyOwner.reason: He already provided the clearest issue guidance and has strong recent history in model CLI, status probes, and fallback behavior.
